clare (docs): FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299 has docs-preview failing for an SDK snippet import error. Can't repro locally.

mike (eng): can you paste the exact error line?

clare (docs): `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic_core'` during autodoc when building docs.

ci-bot: docs-preview check failed  job 9140  missing dependency during Sphinx build.

jenna (devex): we've hit pydantic-core issues on GH Actions (python 3.11) before. Local devs often use 3.9/3.10 so it slips by.

mike (eng): quick fix: add a short "docs-smoke" step to run `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` in the action matrix and do `python -c "import pydantic_core"` to fail fast. I'll open a tiny PR with that workflow snippet.

sam (platform): related: auto-merge triggered even though docs-preview failed because that check is optional in branch protection. We should make auto-merge require docs-preview/docs-smoke when changes touch docs/.

clare (docs): agreed. CODEOWNERS also needs a tweak so migration and SDK guides ping the docs team first. Current file routes some guides to platform. I can open a CODEOWNERS PR adding `/docs/guides/migrate-* @clare-docs @devex`.

jenna (devex): note: we don't want to slow down tiny typo fixes. Proposal: keep docs-preview optional globally but make the auto-merge bot path-aware: if files_changed start with `docs/` then require `docs-smoke` + `docs-preview`. That avoids broad branch protection churn.

mike (eng): perfect. I'll add the smoke job and update the auto-merge condition in the merge workflow. Example smoke snippet I'll push: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && python -c "import pydantic_core" && make -C docs html -q`.

sam (platform): I'll update the auto-merge rules to check changed paths and require the two doc checks before enqueueing merges. Will coordinate with security for the change.

clare (docs): action items: (1) clare PR to tweak CODEOWNERS (2) mike PR to add docs-smoke to workflow (3) sam update auto-merge path rules (4) jenna add a short CONTRIBUTING blurb recommending local python and `make docs-serve`. I'll hold off merging #1299 until smoke+preview pass. Thanks! :thumbsup:
